group_assessment.weighting: Two Korean dermatology departments (Soonchunhyang and Chungnam National University); a group that publishes keratinocyte biology and psoriasis; WWOX appears as a candidate in their own survey of a methylation dataset. Not a WWOX-disease group; the paper is a first mechanistic look at WWOX in a skin model.

entries.proposition: Introduction cites reference 17 for decreased WWOX in lung and ovarian cancer correlating with metastasis; reference 17 in the list is a paper titled as loss of lung WWOX expression causing neutrophilic inflammation (the opposite sign to this knockdown result), which the Discussion never addresses.
entries.snippet: The decrease in WWOX expression, observed in diverse cancer types including lung and ovarian cancer, correlates with increased tumor metastasis and poorer prognosis.

entries.proposition: Starting point: the authors say mechanistic investigation of WWOX in psoriasis is lacking, citing a methylation study in which WWOX was hypomethylated and more transcribed in psoriatic skin.
